summary:
How can farmers plan their crops while considering the environmental conditions of their land?

CropWise was created to address this question. It is a web-based platform that transforms NASA environmental data and agricultural references into accessible information to explore potential planting windows and plan crop cycles.

Our solution integrates data from NASA POWER, products accessed through AppEEARS, and agricultural references from EcoCrop, applying environmental analysis methods to support informed decisions.

Through an interactive map, farmers register their land, explore historical temperature and precipitation data, and compare these conditions with the requirements of different crops.

Using this information, they can identify potential planting windows, select crop cycles, and organize them into an annual agricultural plan.

CropWise addresses the "Field Shifts" challenge by helping farmers explore crop sequences and potential rotation strategies focused on responsible resource use, especially water.

Our goal is not to replace farmers' knowledge, but to complement their experience with environmental information that supports more informed and sustainable agricultural planning.
details:
CropWise is a web platform that transforms historical environmental data into visual information to support agricultural planning. Farmers can register and define their field boundaries on an interactive map, explore temperature and precipitation conditions, and compare them with crop requirements to identify potential planting windows.

The platform allows users to select crop cycles, identify environmental considerations, and organize them into an annual plan that can be saved and accessed later. This helps farmers explore different crop sequences based on their field conditions and agricultural knowledge.

To develop CropWise, we used data from NASA POWER, Earth observation products accessed through AppEEARS, and agricultural references from EcoCrop. We also performed environmental analyses, including evapotranspiration and water balance calculations, as well as elevation-based temperature adjustments. The project combines data processing, web development, and UX/UI design, using tools such as Figma and Figma Make.

CropWise's innovation lies in connecting geographic location, environmental changes over time, and crop requirements within a single interactive experience. Rather than presenting scientific data in isolation, it transforms them into contextualized information that enables farmers to explore different scenarios and build personalized agricultural plans.

In response to the "Field Shifts challenge", CropWise aims to support more informed agricultural decisions and the exploration of crop rotation strategies that consider responsible water use. In the future, we hope to expand the platform to more crops and regions and incorporate additional criteria to promote sustainable farming practices.
